strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill itch-publish，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use for "upload to itch", an HTML5 game that downloads instead of playing, a blank or 403 web build, or "invalid target".
Workflow: The page must exist first; Work out the target; Install butler; Prepare a portable build folder.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：steam-publish 用 gene_gdsk_steam_publish_v1，game-jam 用 gene_gdsk_game_jam_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
